result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.rev_edge_dir_ws()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Reverse the direction of all selected edges (directed graphs only). ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L13441-L13519){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.rev_edge_dir_ws() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} For each selected edge (A->B), changes it to (B->A). Edge IDs and all attributes (including weights) are preserved during reversal. Only the direction is changed. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the graph is undirected (undirected edges have no direction to reverse). ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} - only works on directed graphs - edge attributes and IDs remain unchanged - selection state is preserved after reversal ## Examples {.doc-examples} Reverse specific edges: ::: {#18e8a648 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph(directed=True) graph.add_node("A") graph.add_node("B") graph.add_edge("A", "B", weight=1.5) # Reverse the edge direction edge_ids = graph.get_edge_ids() graph.select_edges_by_id([edge_ids[0]]) graph.rev_edge_dir_ws() # Edge now goes B -> A source, target = graph.get_node_ids_by_edge_id(edge_ids[0]) # Returns B -> A (source and target node IDs) (source, target) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` (2, 1) ``` ::: ::: ::: {#8ea0fd6b .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Weight is preserved edge = graph.get_edge(edge_ids[0]) # Returns 1.5 edge.weight ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 1.5 ``` ::: ::: Reverse all edges in a subgraph: ::: {#73d16c42 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ec.Graph(directed=True) graph.add_path_graph(4) # 0->1->2->3 # Reverse middle edges edge_ids = graph.get_edge_ids()[1:3] graph.select_edges_by_id(edge_ids) graph.rev_edge_dir_ws() # Path is now: 0->1<-2<-3 ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` Number of nodes : 4 Number of edges : 3 Directed : True Density : 0.25 Average degree (min, max) : 1.50 (1, 2) Strongly connected : False Weakly connected : True Number of strongly connected components : 4 Number of weakly connected components : 1 ``` ::: :::
